speaker: johan_vosloo
headline: KOEBERG TRUST IS BUILT BY CONTAINMENT.
deck: Technical safety becomes public confidence when monitoring, disclosure and containment all work.
quote: Safety earns trust when the state discloses quickly and contains decisively.
facts: Eskom said there was no radiation leak at Koeberg Unit 2.
Brief detections occurred inside a controlled maintenance area.
The event was rated INES Level 0 with no safety significance.
Monitoring, filtration and radiation-protection systems worked as designed.
takeaway: Technical competence and transparent disclosure are part of public order.
